page.layout: One page of text in a single column, running head above the text, catchword and signature at the foot. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: autem dictionis, Romani, apponendum est, Græci, quippe Græcis junioribus Pω-μᾶϊον[?] idem esse constat, atque Latinè Græcum, à quibus illa dictio postea ad cæteras Regionum Orientalium nationes transiit; quin & alii errores in hisce Epistolis à Morino in Latinum Sermonem conversis deprehendantur, nullius dubito: verùm de his autographa consulere necesse fuerit, dignæ tamen sunt, quæ publici juris fiant, cùm illarum beneficio Samaritanorum religio, mores, ac ritus illustrari possint. Eadem Samaritanorum natio de eodem argumento ad quosdam Ecclesiæ Anglicanæ Theo-logos scripsit Literas, quæ cum iis partem maximam consentiunt; significa-verat etiam Perescius[?] in eadem Epistola Morino, exemplar versionisSamaritanæ, quod erat Petri à Valle, quodque in Bibliis Parisiensibus excusum fuit, non esse bonæ notæ, mendisque fœdissimis illud scatere, similiter penes se habere longè pluresSamaritanorum siclos,eosque longè perfectiores, quám qvos in exercita-

page.notes: Printing faults kept as printed: "versionisSamaritanæ", "pluresSamaritanorum", "siclos,eosque" run together without spaces. The Greek word after "Pω-" is uncertain in its accents. "Perescius" is read from a blurred name and is uncertain. "qvám" is printed with a u-form and is transcribed as quám. The left-margin fragments are edge of the neighbouring page and are not transcribed.
